videos.title: The Gentle Rhythm Between Two Steady Notes #math #Shorts

editorial.opening: Two tuning forks and an invitation to listen introduce the relationship. The first tones begin at9.125seconds; opening still has a verbal lead-in.
editorial.mechanism: Equal and opposed schematic waves visibly sum; exact1Hzand.5Hz envelopes appear during original tone windows. Schematic carrier motion is explicitly labeled.
editorial.readability: Frequency labels were moved above the forks to remove waveform crossings. Caption text remains separate.
editorial.pacing: Two speech-free windows preserve real-time beats, with short gaps elsewhere. Decoded envelopes match authored timing.
editorial.sound: Local narration; beats film uses two original tone windows with verified final envelopes. Other films are dry. Full ASR reviewed, including repaired tea wording. No subjective listening.
editorial.remaining_weaknesses: No subjective listening. The two forks remain rigid icons; the final formula holds for many seconds. An audible isolated-tone comparison could strengthen the claim that each note is steady.
editorial.audience_evidence: Not measured. No retention, recognition, learning or subscription results yet.

videos.title: The Quiet Curve Inside a Cooling Cup #math #Shorts

editorial.opening: A cup, handle and saucer provide a recognizable quiet scene. The gap readout begins changing.
editorial.mechanism: The room-temperature baseline persists while gaps halve; the same tracker later maps to a curve.
editorial.readability: Decimal readouts preserve27.5ratherthanroundingto28. Captions and equations occupy separate regions.
editorial.pacing: The ambiguous word halve was replaced by cuts the remaining gap in half; updated full ASR recovered it.
editorial.sound: Local narration; beats film uses two original tone windows with verified final envelopes. Other films are dry. Full ASR reviewed, including repaired tea wording. No subjective listening.
editorial.remaining_weaknesses: Cup temperature is carried by a separate gauge; color is not a physical thermal rendering. The final cup and curve stay mostly still. No subjective prosody assessment.

videos.title: A Tree Measured by Its Smaller Companion #math #Shorts

editorial.opening: A sparse tree and stick introduce an accessible outdoor measurement.
editorial.mechanism: The small triangle scales onto the large one, explicitly matching height and shadow. Both shadows later shorten together.
editorial.readability: Foliage is contained below the actual measured height; numeric labels moved off the sides they measure.
editorial.pacing: A comparison hold makes correspondence visible; scope conditions are narrated before the calculation.
editorial.sound: Local narration; beats film uses two original tone windows with verified final envelopes. Other films are dry. Full ASR reviewed, including repaired tea wording. No subjective listening.
editorial.remaining_weaknesses: The tree remains a sparse icon and the scene is a split side-view rather than an outdoor composition. A low initial shadow contrast may not communicate a natural shadow without the words.

videos.title: The Coin That Looks Closer Than It Is #math #Shorts

editorial.opening: A coin and its faint actual position show apparent displacement before rays appear.
editorial.mechanism: Exact refracted rays and dashed backward extensions locate the virtual image; depth arrows distinguish actual and apparent.
editorial.readability: Small-angle approximation is stated in narration and visible text. The two coins are small but separable.
editorial.pacing: One path is built at a time, then held while the virtual-image distinction is explained.
editorial.sound: Local narration; beats film uses two original tone windows with verified final envelopes. Other films are dry. Full ASR reviewed, including repaired tea wording. No subjective listening.

videos.title: The Average Hidden in a Walk to the Pond #math #Shorts

editorial.opening: Home, pond and a walker introduce an everyday comparison.
editorial.mechanism: Outward and return motion have a2:1durationratio; time bars make the weighting visible before the harmonic formula.
editorial.readability: Labels fade during replacement. Equal-time bars replace unequal-time bars without stale duration labels.
editorial.pacing: The numeric answer arrives before the general formula, followed by the equal-time contrast.
editorial.sound: Local narration; beats film uses two original tone windows with verified final envelopes. Other films are dry. Full ASR reviewed, including repaired tea wording. No subjective listening.
editorial.remaining_weaknesses: The walker slides without a gait, and the pond is only an ellipse. Symbols u and v are implicit as the two speeds. Much of the latter half is a static diagram.
